title: Amma's (Jan's) Strawberry Pie
description: A classic chilled strawberry pie with a glossy strawberry filling in a baked crust, topped with whipped cream.

steps.instruction: Bake the pie crust according to package directions and let it cool completely.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, cornstarch, and water. Cook over medium heat until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in strawberry gelatin until dissolved.
Let the mixture cool completely, stirring occasionally.
Arrange sliced strawberries in the cooled pie crust.
Pour the cooled filling over the strawberries.
Chill in the refrigerator until set.
